candidates.concept: PATIENCE VESSEL DROPS A NOTCH PER YES
candidates.compositionSketch: leftTextRightObject: headline left; tall notched vessel right; each landed 'YES' label drops the level one notch
candidates.whyDifferent: Pure subtractive drain measured notch-by-notch; no stacking, looping, or fragmentation — the resource simply leaves
candidates.strength: Level falls 1:1 with each 'yes' — viewer counts the loss without narration

candidates.compositionSketch: centered: beam on fulcrum under top label; each approval token lands, beam tilts further, 'SELF' marker sinks below baseline
candidates.whyDifferent: Physical loading rather than draining — fatigue accrues as weight on the askers' side, causing visible sag
candidates.strength: Tilt angle and sinking marker grow per token: cause and cost read instantly

candidates.compositionSketch: centered: circle with rotating arc-arrow ring; each revolution erases one arc of the circle's own outline; counter 01 to 06
candidates.whyDifferent: Exhaustion as erosion from cycles, not drain of a quantity — the self is what disappears frame by frame
candidates.strength: Outline thinning each revolution performs 'get more tired' as material loss

candidates.compositionSketch: split: text left; right a track where marker advances then slides back — STEP counter climbs while DISTANCE stays 00
candidates.whyDifferent: Futility via decoupled counters — effort accumulates but displacement doesn't; not draining or weighting
candidates.strength: Two numbers moving apart state the wasted-energy claim wordlessly

candidates.concept: ONE ANSWER SHATTERS INTO MATCHING SLIVERS
candidates.compositionSketch: typographyDominant: solid 'ANSWER' splits into four slivers flying to four edge asker-labels, leaving its hollow outline
candidates.whyDifferent: Fragmentation of a single identity object, not time-based drain — cost is shape and mass, not energy
candidates.strength: A solid thing going hollow while pieces scatter enacts self-reshaping literally

candidates.concept: YES RESHAPES TO FIT EACH SLOT
candidates.compositionSketch: leftTextRightObject: label 'YOUR ANSWER' left; right a solid block labeled YES re-forming into three different outline slots arriving in sequence
candidates.whyDifferent: The answer itself is the actor and physically changes shape to fit incoming requests — morphing is the mechanism, not crossing out or shrinking
candidates.strength: Viewer watches one word lose its own form three times; the re-forming reads as self-betrayal without narration

candidates.compositionSketch: asymmetric: stacked revision lines, each a version of the same answer labeled TAKE 1–TAKE 5, earlier takes fading as later ones overwrite
candidates.whyDifferent: Uses sequential overwriting/re-editing rather than shape morphing — history of the same answer changing per asker
candidates.strength: Seeing five contradictory versions of one stance makes the editing habit undeniable and unease-producing

candidates.compositionSketch: centered: a single upright statement bar; asking pointers arrive from alternating sides and the bar tilts toward each one in turn
candidates.whyDifferent: The answer stays one object but its orientation is bent by external pressure — direction, not shape or content, changes
candidates.strength: The tilt is a physical confession of yielding; each re-tilt visibly costs the bar its upright position

candidates.compositionSketch: split: left answer flips orientation each time a question marker appears; right answer holds the same orientation through identical markers
candidates.whyDifferent: Contrast of two behaviors side by side instead of following one answer through change
candidates.strength: The fixed line's stillness next to the flapping one shows the self-betrayal purely through differential motion

candidates.concept: EVERY MATCH COSTS THE YES ITS WEIGHT
candidates.compositionSketch: topTextBottomObject: headline 'YOUR YES' above; below a solid block depletes to outline to hairline with each shape-shift event
candidates.whyDifferent: Measures consequence — substance drains with each change — rather than showing the change itself
candidates.strength: Diminishing mass makes 'stops meaning anything' tangible; the final hairline is the emotional endpoint

candidates.concept: YES repeated until it is noise
candidates.compositionSketch: typographyDominant: three stacked YES lines, crisp → tight → blurred smear; one hairline underline
candidates.whyDifferent: Uses repetition itself as the decay engine — meaning destroyed by quantity, not weight or erosion
candidates.strength: Viewer watches a legible word become unreadable texture — semantic satiation performed

candidates.concept: Value meter drains each time YES is given
candidates.compositionSketch: leftTextRightObject: left label 'VALUE OF ONE YES'; right vertical meter empties from near-full gold to a hairline
candidates.whyDifferent: Frames credibility as a spendable stock that depletes per transaction — a resource account
candidates.strength: A full bar falling to zero reads instantly as 'being used up'

candidates.concept: The answer reshapes itself to every asker
candidates.compositionSketch: rightTextLeftObject: one answer-arrow pivots to three faint asker ticks, ending pointing sideways at nothing
candidates.whyDifferent: Morphing pivot instead of decay — shows 'bend to match' as an identity never holding one direction
candidates.strength: A shape that keeps re-aiming and ends aimed nowhere physically shows the lost stance

candidates.concept: YES count climbs, applause stays at zero
candidates.compositionSketch: topTextBottomObject: top label 'TIMES YOU SAID YES' rising counter; bottom applause meter pinned flat at 00
candidates.whyDifferent: Plays two counters against each other instead of degrading one object — irony lives in the gap
candidates.strength: Rising number vs dead one delivers hollowness without narration

candidates.concept: One YES thins to a hairline and dissolves
candidates.compositionSketch: asymmetric: single gold YES losing stroke weight stage by stage — solid, outline, thread, gone; faint hairline left
candidates.whyDifferent: Physical erosion of one single instance — no repetition, no meter, no counter
candidates.strength: Subtractive change on one hero object makes 'stops meaning anything' literal

candidates.compositionSketch: split: left half a stack of 4-5 smeared offset outline copies, each slightly rotated and low opacity; right half one solid crisp teal mark; thin divider hairline
candidates.whyDifferent: Unlike the twin-silhouette gold-tag comparison, this contrasts instability itself — self-copies multiplied by re-editing blur — against a single undiluted form; the difference is clarity, not labeling.
candidates.strength: The blur visually IS indecision accumulated; the crisp mark reads as conviction before any word is processed — the viewer sees who gets remembered instantly.

candidates.compositionSketch: leftTextRightObject: label and subheadline left; right a circular dial whose arrow needle sweeps several ticks, settles hard on one tick that gains a lock notch while other ticks dim
candidates.whyDifferent: A decision mechanism, not a contrast of states: the scene performs the act of choosing a direction and holding it (verbs: choose, stay) rather than comparing two people.
candidates.strength: The physical stop of the needle — motion ending in a fixed position — enacts 'hold one direction' with no narration; the lock notch confirms permanence.

candidates.compositionSketch: topTextBottomObject: subheadline top; below, a 6-slot timeline where identical teal marks stamp in one by one into an unbroken line, while a second row of varied shapes stays mostly empty
candidates.whyDifferent: Uses accumulated identical repetition over time (consistency as memory-building) rather than side-by-side contrast or a single locking gesture.
candidates.strength: The unbroken row literally becomes the thing the eye remembers in-frame, mirroring how a consistent person becomes memorable in reality.

candidates.concept: HELD ANSWER ECHOES, BENT ANSWER DIES
candidates.compositionSketch: asymmetric: lower-left a small solid dot emitting 3 expanding concentric arcs across the negative space; upper-right a soft irregular line that emits nothing and dissolves
candidates.whyDifferent: Causal propagation instead of comparison: it shows WHY consistency is remembered — a fixed stance produces lasting ripples, while re-shaped answers produce no follow-through signal.
candidates.strength: Expanding arcs read as influence and recall spreading outward; the silent dissolving line makes 'stops meaning anything' visible without words.

candidates.compositionSketch: typographyDominant: a large text line visibly rewrites itself with flickering word swaps and a blinking caret for a beat, then the final version locks, caret vanishes, line settles and lifts
candidates.whyDifferent: Text-object self-modification, not shapes or dials: the headline itself performs 'stop editing' and 'yes stops meaning anything', making typography the actor.
candidates.strength: Anyone who has re-written a reply recognizes the flickering swap instantly; the moment the caret vanishes delivers finality as a felt event.

candidates.compositionSketch: leftTextRightObject — headline block left at 8% margin; right side a tall counter '00' above a vertical stack of edit ticks that accumulate
candidates.whyDifferent: Measures the transaction directly: repeated edit inputs are logged while the output counter never moves — the only candidate quantifying payoff instead of showing identity change or motion of objects toward an audience.
candidates.strength: A counter that visibly refuses to increment after each added tick makes 'unpaid approval' readable in one glance without narration.

candidates.compositionSketch: centered — one solid form center-frame loses a facet with each beat until only a faint sliver remains; small label beneath reads 'KEEP MATCHING'
candidates.whyDifferent: Enacts identity erosion as physical material loss over time, rather than counting, looping, or throwing — the object itself is what changes.
candidates.strength: Watching a whole form get whittled to a sliver makes the cost of self-editing viscerally clear; no explanation needed.

candidates.compositionSketch: typographyDominant — three stacked answer lines, each struck through and rewritten, the third landing pixel-identical to the first; hairline loop arc connects line three back to line one
candidates.whyDifferent: Uses temporal repetition of text itself (with a closing loop arc) instead of object depletion or counters — the meaning lives in the words returning unchanged.
candidates.strength: Seeing the third answer land exactly where the first began proves change produces nothing; the loop arc seals the argument visually.

candidates.compositionSketch: split — left: a single crisp form anchored on one gold baseline; right: a fan of dim translucent former versions dissolving upward
candidates.whyDifferent: Contrasts consistency against accumulated alternatives side-by-side, where the held version is the only one that stays solid — comparison, not sequence or measurement.
candidates.strength: The solidity-vs-ghost split states the reframe instantly: one fixed stance survives, all the edits are already fading.

candidates.concept: ANSWERS DIE AT THE FOURTH WALL
candidates.compositionSketch: topTextBottomObject — headline top; below, answer cards travel right toward a single vertical hairline and dissolve on contact, never crossing it
candidates.whyDifferent: Shows the audience as an unreachable boundary — effort expended toward a target that terminates it, distinct from counting, looping, depleting, or juxtaposing versions.
candidates.strength: Cards visibly expiring at an invisible line dramatizes effort wasted before it can ever be received — the performance has nowhere to land.

candidates.compositionSketch: typographyDominant: headline top-left; below, 5 bearing lines from one origin — 4 dim teal stubs, 1 gold line extends to frame edge and locks with a tick
candidates.whyDifferent: Makes the choosing act literal — several directions exist, one is picked and extended; others remain as unchosen potential.
candidates.strength: The extending gold line reads as commitment without words: one path travels far, the rest never start.

candidates.compositionSketch: leftTextRightObject: label left; right, an arc gauge needle sweeps erratically, decelerates onto one gold tick, then a lock bracket closes and it stops
candidates.whyDifferent: Uses mechanical locking rather than selection — the drama is the stopping of wobble, matching 'stay with it'.
candidates.strength: Erratic-then-still motion is felt physically; the bracket clamping shut reads as a decision made final.

candidates.compositionSketch: split: left, a jagged path wanders and fades unresolved; right, a single straight gold rule draws edge to edge under subheadline 'STOP EDITING'
candidates.whyDifferent: Contrast mechanism — juxtaposes the cost of drift against a fixed line, closing the arc from earlier bending-answer scenes.
candidates.strength: The jagged line dying versus the straight line completing itself argues the point before any narration.

candidates.concept: IDENTICAL ANSWERS REPEAT ON ONE AXIS
candidates.compositionSketch: topTextBottomObject: subheadline 'SAME YES, EVERY TIME'; below, identical gold ticks stamp at even intervals along one axis, marching right
candidates.whyDifferent: Consistency as repetition — commitment proven by unvarying recurrence rather than a single decisive moment.
candidates.strength: Perfect alignment of repeated marks visually equals integrity; viewers read evenness as trustworthiness.

candidates.concept: SIDE FORCE CANNOT BEND THE LINE
candidates.compositionSketch: asymmetric: gold vertical line at center; dim teal arrows strike from both sides, deflect away, line stays plumb; headline left 'AND HOLD IT'
candidates.whyDifferent: Tests the chosen direction against opposition instead of showing the choosing — resolve proven under load.
candidates.strength: Deflected arrows physically demonstrate principled stubbornness; nothing needs explaining.
